entries.title: Trump scraps threat of 20% fee on Hormuz cargo as US resumes blockade of Iran ports
entries.snippet: Trump drops a 24-hour-old vow to charge cargo ships for using the Strait as the US continues its battle to break Iran's hold on the waterway.

entries.title: Strait of Hormuz 'faultline' exposes weakness of the US-Iran deal
entries.snippet: Control of the waterway has become a key point of contention between the US and Iran, as a ceasefire deal falters.

entries.title: Israeli strike on police post in north Gaza kills seven, officials say
entries.snippet: A senior officer in the Hamas-run police force was among those killed in the strike, which Israel's military says targeted "terrorists".

entries.title: Diamond giant De Beers halts work at flagship South African mine as demand plummets
entries.snippet: Production will stop for two years at the mine which employs more than 4,000 people.

entries.title: 'If we die, we die together': Wife of man nearly sucked out of Ryanair plane speaks of ordeal
entries.snippet: Svetlana Grković told Serbian media that her husband is "seriously injured and in shock".

entries.title: Trump pays writer E Jean Carroll $5m in damages over sexual abuse and defamation
entries.snippet: The president had sought to delay the payment as he tried to persuade the Supreme Court to overturn the judgement.

entries.title: Tyrannosaurus rex most expensive dinosaur ever sold
entries.snippet: The dinosaur skeleton, which roamed the planet 67 million years ago, was sold by Sotheby's in New York.

entries.title: Bangkok fire investigation finds locked doors and flammable decor as deaths climb to 30
entries.snippet: Survivors and first responders reported locked doors and a lack of signage marking emergency exits.

entries.title: Singapore court orders Bloomberg to pay $356,000 to ministers in defamation case
entries.snippet: The ministers claimed the piece, which cited their luxury bungalow deals, had tarnished their reputation.

entries.title: How US commerce secretary's Epstein links were uncovered by British whistleblower
entries.snippet: Simon Andriesz made the discovery about Howard Lutnick in publicly released Epstein files.

entries.title: Australian police reveal unseen photos 25 years after British backpacker murder
entries.snippet: Police hope the images could jog memories that will help them find the body of Peter Falconio.

entries.title: Hungary parliament votes to remove president from office
entries.snippet: Tamás Sulyok was widely seen as a loyalist of former prime minister Viktor Orbán, who lost power in April after 16 years.

entries.title: US judge voids Donald Trump's $1.8bn settlement with IRS that gave him immunity from tax audits
entries.snippet: The judge said the suit was brought for 'improper purposes' and referred a Trump attorney for possible disciplinary action.

entries.title: Yemen's Houthis launch missiles at Saudi Arabia after strikes on Sanaa airport
entries.snippet: The Iran-backed Houthis blame Saudi Arabia for the attack in Yemen's capital and say they targeted Abha airport in response.

entries.title: Colombian national killed by ICE agent during operation in Maine
entries.snippet: It comes less than a week after an undocumented migrant was fatally shot in Houston by an immigration agent.

entries.title: Identity of Sydney daycare worker facing 329 child abuse offences revealed
entries.snippet: Hamish Tait is accused of abusing 136 children at five childcare facilities over a 16-year period.

entries.title: EU bans gold imports from Sudan to curb money financing the war
entries.snippet: The ban also restricts exports of mercury and cyanide to Sudan, chemicals widely used in gold mining.

entries.title: Bison rams grandfather in Yellowstone Park, knocking him metres into the air
entries.snippet: The man and his grandson appeared a safe distance away from the bison before it quickly chased them down.

entries.title: Health fears as frail Indian activist on hunger strike loses 8.2kg
entries.snippet: The environmental activist has been on a hunger strike for 16 days and is getting visibly weaker.

entries.title: US burrito giant Chipotle opening first outlet in Mexico
entries.snippet: Other US fast-food brands have struggled to succeed in the countries their dishes originated in.

entries.title: Spain sparkles to shock France 2-0 and advance to the World Cup final
entries.snippet: Spain is back in the men's World Cup final for the first time since 2010. That's also when Spain won its only World Cup title. France had hoped to reach the final for the third straight tournament.

entries.title: How do young people feel about AI? 7 teens weigh in
entries.snippet: What's it like to grow up and learn in the age of AI? NPR put that question to seven teenagers across the country.

entries.title: In the aftermath of deadly shootings, ICE pauses most traffic stops
entries.snippet: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement will pause non-urgent vehicle stops after two deadly shootings in less than a week, Maine U.S. Sen. Angus King's office tells NPR.

entries.title: E. Jean Carroll receives $5.6 million from Trump in sexual abuse and defamation case
entries.snippet: The payment comes three years after a jury found President Trump liable for sexually abusing and defaming the writer.

entries.title: Environmental groups sue government to stop a big change to the Endangered Species Act
entries.snippet: By altering the definition of the word "harm" as used by the Endangered Species Act, the Trump administration may limit how wildlife is protected in the United States. Environmental groups are suing.

entries.title: Investigative journalist reports on the abuse inside ICE's largest detention facility
entries.snippet: The New Yorker writer Jonathan Blitzer says thousands of people are being held in tents in the El Paso desert, where inhumane conditions have become a tool to pressure people to accept deportation.

entries.title: Some international artists are skipping U.S. tours. Others may follow suit
entries.snippet: The visa process for visiting artists has always been complicated and expensive. Under the current administration, it's gotten significantly worse.

entries.title: Inflation slowed sharply -- but it may not last
entries.snippet: Annual inflation hit 3.5% in June, down from May's more than three-year high — but the resumption of the conflict with Iran threaten to push up inflation as energy costs once again spike.

entries.title: U.S. to reinstate Hormuz blockade. And, states sue over Paramount-Warner deal
entries.snippet: The United States plans to reinstate a blockade over the Strait of Hormuz today. And, several states are suing to stop the massive Paramount-Warner Bros. merger.

entries.title: Family of a man shot by agents responding to a 911 call seeks answers
entries.snippet: A troubling pattern of federal agents fatally shooting civilians is developing, with deaths in Maine, Texas and Tennessee. The family of a man shot by agents told NPR they want answers.

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Jay Clayton testifies in confirmation hearing for director of national intelligence
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump picked Clayton for the role last month amid pressure from Congress to name Tulsi Gabbard's permanent replacement.

entries.title: WATCH: House passes bill to make daylight saving time permanent
entries.snippet: There will be no turning back the clock if the House has its way. The House passed a bill Tuesday that would make daylight saving time permanent. Proponents, including the White House, argued the change would provide more daylight during the times that Americans are most active.

entries.title: Maine Democrats criticize GOP Sen. Susan Collins after fatal ICE shooting of motorist in the state
entries.snippet: A federal immigration agent fatally shot a motorist just south of Maine's largest city on Monday, the second time in a week that ICE has used deadly force on American soil and at least the ninth death since President Donald Trump began his immigration crackdown.

entries.title: Maine Sen. King says feds lack credibility, locals need role in ICE shooting investigation
entries.snippet: A 26-year-old Colombian national was shot and killed in Maine after ICE agents attempted to pull him over while he was driving. ICE said Joan Sebastian Guerrero tried to flee and used his vehicle as a weapon, prompting an agent to fire in self-defense. It comes after a man in Hou

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Todd Blanche testifies in confirmation hearing for attorney general
entries.snippet: Blanche is heading into a high-stakes test this week in his bid to become attorney general, with key Republicans still undecided about whether to back his nomination.

entries.title: Spain scores 2-0 win over France, advancing to World Cup final
entries.snippet: Spain will face either defending champion Argentina or England on Sunday in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

entries.title: WATCH: Senate Democrats block $1 trillion annual defense bill in protest over Iran war

entries.title: WATCH: Trump says he's reversing course on Strait of Hormuz fees because Gulf states will invest in U.S.
entries.snippet: The president explained his thinking in backing away from a 20% toll on cargo passing through the Strait of Hormuz, saying he was called by "kings and emirs" and other leaders who suggested an alternate arrangement.

entries.title: Trump administration orders ICE to suspend most vehicle stops after deadly shootings
entries.snippet: The suspension is not absolute and there's room for exceptions when executing a criminal warrant or working with partner agencies.

entries.title: Cyclosporiasis infections are surging. Michigan officials say lettuce is a possible cause
entries.snippet: In Michigan — where more than 3,300 cases have been reported — officials say early information points to lettuce or salad greens as a possible culprit.

entries.title: U.S. launches additional strikes on Iran ahead of restoring blockade, official says
entries.snippet: The U.S. carried out another wave of strikes ahead of its planned reimposition of a blockade on Iran's ports, a U.S. official told The Associated Press on condition of anonymity to discuss a sensitive military operation.

entries.title: WATCH: Trump says FBI is 'wasting their time' if agency is investigating Sen. Graham's death
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump said he doesn't know why the FBI is looking into Sen. Lindsey Graham's death.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: How Turkey's 2016 coup attempt changed the country for good
entries.snippet: Ten years ago, parts of the Turkish military attempted to overthrow the government of President Erdogan. The consequences of the failed coup continue to shape Turkey to this day. A look back.

entries.title: US troop withdrawal from Iraq set for September, 30
entries.snippet: The planned US withdrawal is linked to the disarmament of influential, Iran-backed militias in Iraq.

entries.title: Iranian newspaper threatens Germany's Chancellor Merz
entries.snippet: A major Iranian newspaper has published a threat of "retaliation" against German Chancellor Friedrich Merz. Politicians have expressed concern, and the German government has issued a cautious response.

entries.title: T. rex 'Gus' sells for record-breaking $50.1 million
entries.snippet: The Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton surpassed its pre-sale estimate and set a new auction record for a dinosaur fossil.

entries.title: US-Iraq relations: Can Iran-allied militias be disarmed?
entries.snippet: When Donald Trump meets Iraq's new PM today, they are likely to discuss disarming Iran's allies in Iraq. Some have already pledged to give up their guns. But is that likely? And will it influence the US-Iran war?

entries.title: Ebola outbreak much larger than official figures, WHO says
entries.snippet: The outbreak, which has infected almost 2,000 people and killed over 700, could be at least two to four times larger than official figures, the UN health agency warned. The current outbreak is in the DRC and Uganda.

entries.title: Ukraine parliament accepts PM Svyrydenko's resignation
entries.snippet: It comes as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy moves to reshuffle the cabinet as Ukraine was "changing its political strategy."

entries.title: Iran war: US launches new round of strikes
entries.snippet: The US military said the strikes were "to continue degrading Iranian capabilities." Iran meanwhile has said the US renewed blockade "dismantles" the truce deal.

entries.title: As the world rearms, South Korea aims to cash in
entries.snippet: Weapons and military equipment produced in South Korea are sought-after due to their reliability, speedy delivery times and relatively low prices. Global demand for weapons has surged after Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

entries.title: Nigeria offers clues to new US Africa strategy
entries.snippet: The withdrawal of US troops from Nigeria after the killing of an "Islamic State" leader may be less about leaving Africa than redefining how Washington fights terrorism on the continent.

entries.title: Micronutrients are good, a balanced diet is better
entries.snippet: Chronic illnesses, heart disease, obesity ― we know eating too much of the wrong foods can be unhealthy. But what about "good" foods: Is modern farming diluting micronutrients in our fruit and vegetables?

entries.title: Ukraine targets another 11 Russian ships in Sea of Azov
entries.snippet: Ukraine said it struck tankers and cargo vessels in the Sea of Azov, in the latest strikes on Russian commercial shipping. Moscow's Agriculture Ministry said "alternative shipping routes" are being sought.

entries.title: Bastille Day: France holds parade with Ukraine in focus
entries.snippet: The celebrations featured troops and warplanes from around Europe in a show of support for Ukraine, as it fends off Russia's ongoing invasion. It was Emmanuel Macron's last Bastille Day as France's president.

entries.title: Germany news: Military conscientious objections spike
entries.snippet: The number of people applying for conscientious objection to military service has risen sharply and there were around 5,100 heat-related deaths recorded in June alone.

entries.title: France arrests arson suspects amid Fontainebleau forest fire
entries.snippet: Firefighters are attempting to tackle a major fire burning since Sunday in the much-visited Fontainebleau forest, near France's capital Paris. Two people have been arrested for suspected arson.

entries.title: Germany's Ahr Valley: Rebuilding better after deadly flood
entries.snippet: New walls, redesigned bridges and restored floodplains: Towns in a small German valley are testing how they can survive the next extreme flood.

entries.title: India news: Sonam Wangchuk's hunger strike tests Modi
entries.snippet: Indian activist Sonam Wangchuks has been fasting in protest of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan since over two weeks. As his health deteriorates, the pressure piles up on Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

entries.title: Death toll in Bangkok bar fire reaches 30
entries.snippet: As Bangkok kicks-off an investigation into a fire in a bar last Sunday, three people among the wounded have died. The number of deaths from the blaze now stand at 30.

entries.title: US: 12 states challenge Paramount's buyout of Warner
entries.snippet: The states have filed a lawsuit arguing that a merger of Hollywood giant studios Paramount and Warner would "extinguish competition" and increase consumer prices.
